sources.title: Excited State Dynamics of Methyl Viologen. Ultrafast Photoreduction in Methanol and Fluorescence in Acetonitrile
sources.scope: dimethyl viologen molecular analogue; excited-state/salt-concentration observations
sources.observation: Similar MeCN spectra/dynamics were reported for the PF6 salt and a saturated chloride solution; concentration-dependent fluorescence was discussed as evidence for predominantly free ions.
sources.limitations: No MeCN chloride association constant or experimental uncertainty suitable for direct ground-state DeltaG validation; concentration-series salt identity is not fully specified in the discussion.

sources.title: Heterogeneous Electron-Transfer Rates for the Reduction of Viologen Derivatives at Platinum and Bismuth Electrodes in Acetonitrile
sources.scope: methyl/tethered viologens in PF6 supporting electrolyte
sources.observation: Migration and Frumkin analyses support a dication description under the stated MeCN/PF6 conditions.
sources.limitations: This supports a scoped ionic-model control; PF6 electrochemistry is not a chloride quaternization or polymer-graft equilibrium benchmark.

sources.title: Association of ionic liquids in solution: a combined dielectric and conductivity study of [bmim][Cl] in water and in acetonitrile
sources.limitations: Only the primary abstract was accessible; temperature, uncertainty, standard-state/activity convention and association definition require full-text/SI verification. A different cation cannot validate the exact viologen graft.

screening_outcome: Do not add numerical association endpoints or convert approximate literature K to a validation DeltaG at this stage
